test_accounting: 4955 default core unit tests + 234 selected core integration tests + 8 CLI tests. Focused development and publication reruns are excluded from unique totals.
implementation: Extract the existing analysis grammar into a parser-private typed head and staged outcome; retain existing helpers and the public AST.
Stage the primary analysis, LIN/FFT auxiliary result, output request, Monte Carlo source card, diagnostics and transient-noise selection; publish after complete grammar and cross-card validation.

Share function-bearing card detection with independent sources. Probe the same grammar with an isolated random context, including trailing fields and LIN/noise constraints, before evaluating live once.
AC DATA no longer returns before the common unconsumed-token check; unknown trailing fields now fail instead of being silently discarded.
Keep source ordering, physical owners, source-byte spans, implicit STEP handling and existing control dispatch unchanged.
acceptance_evidence: Public AC DATA accepts a valid named table and rejects extra identifiers, numeric fields, expressions and duplicate DATA clauses.
Private parser tests confirm failed OP/AC/DC/TRAN/FFT/MC cards publish no partial analysis, warnings, output requests, Monte Carlo identity or noise selection.
A failed sampled DC card can retry after its missing value is supplied and uses the first live draw; AUNIF, two-argument LIMIT and user functions are included.
Conflicting sampled transient-noise cards preserve the previous realization and the next live draw; duplicate LIN retains the original auxiliary result.
Mixed public cards preserve OP/DC/AC/TRAN/NOISE/FOUR/MC order and separate Fourier/FFT output ownership. DC/AC/FFT sampled fields draw once in authored order.
The full unit suite includes the existing 29-variant analysis inventory. Selected numerical/control, Fourier, transient-noise and adapter regressions also pass.
limits: Unresolved numeric analysis operands are still rejected. This commit supplies their transaction boundary; pending storage, lexical completion and ordered deferred publication are required next.
All C00-C14 packages remain unfinished, and control dispatch remains 5/29. Analysis parsing does not implement missing solver or control routes.
Function-bearing cards clone a parameter context and parse twice; cancellation latency, total allocation budgets, throughput and peak-memory gates remain open.
Three pre-existing unit tests remain ignored. Selected integrations and optimized WASM tests do not qualify every feature, model, provider or platform.
